body.description: "Admin Abuse" instantly kills a random player.
"Cave Smog" damages you if you are standing below Y level 63.
"Curse of Superflat" flattens the spawn point's y axis and spawns lethal slimes.
"Don't Touch Grass" damages you if you are standing on grass blocks.
"Dripstone Rain" spawns falling dripstone above a player every few seconds.
"End Rift" summons shulkers and fragments of the End.
"Hailstorm" causes hail and thunder to strike the ground, and spreads Frosty's minions across the map.
"Half Health" reduces player max health to five hearts.
"Haunted" spawns several invincible ghasts and phantoms and makes it night.
"Heavy Gravity" sets gravity incredibly high and gives players wind charges.
"Lava Rising" causes lava to rise from the bottom of the world.
"Lethal Jumps" gives you high jumps and low gravity, making you take damage when jumping.
"Lockdown" spawns houses and damages those outside of these houses.
"Minecart Rain" makes it rain tnt minecarts from high above.
"Musical Boats" spawns boats in the sky. Those who aren't in the boat after 45 seconds die.
"Out Of Shape" gives all players weakness and slowness.
"Polluted Water" damages you if you are touching water.
"PvP" enables fighting between players.
"Rapture" levitates all players for 60 seconds.
"Safe Zone" mandates players reach a safe zone in 60 seconds, or die.
"Salmon God" spawns a giant salmon and fills your inventory with salmon.
"Six Feet Under" teleports all players six blocks down every minute.
"Size" randomises player sizes.
"Snowstorm" traps you in a snowstorm, spawning snow and ice monsters.
"Social Distancing" damages players who are too close together.
"Summer Wind" spawns a breeze-riding-blaze for every player alive, above a random player.
"Super Creaking" spawns hyper-strong creaking that occasionally teleport to players.
"Swappage" swaps two players in position every so often.
"Wardens" spawns two wardens in the centre of the map.
"Wither" spawns a wither at the centre of the map.
